neighbours.label: 'By' opening the answer to a 'what/how does X do?' question (method answer)
fire: So how does the drug work? By binding to the receptor, it blocks the signal.
What did the team do next? By sequencing the samples, they found the mutation.
How do bees find flowers? By following scent trails left by others.
So what does this gene do? By deleting it in mice, researchers found out.
How did they lose so much weight? By walking every day for a year.
What does the vaccine do? By training the immune system, it prevents illness.
How was the error found? By comparing the two log files line by line.
So what does the hormone do? By raising blood sugar, it gives energy.
quiet: So how does the drug work? It binds to the receptor and blocks the signal.
What did the team do next? They sequenced the samples and found the mutation.
How do bees find flowers? They follow scent trails left by others.
So what does this gene do? Researchers deleted it in mice to find out.
How did they lose so much weight? They walked every day for a year.
What does the vaccine do? It trains the immune system to prevent illness.
How was the error found? Someone compared the two log files line by line.
So what does the hormone do? It raises blood sugar and gives energy.
